description: Generate one short sound effect (a coin pickup, sword hit, footstep, UI click): a 1-second MP3 saved as an sfx asset in the user's Voidless library. For background music or a looping track use generate_music instead. 5 credits on every call (each call makes and bills a new sound; refunded if it fails); a slow run returns a job for check_generation. Returns the asset ID, the MP3 link and the credits left. For a free sound made at once (114 kinds in 8-bit or high quality, up to 5 seconds, as WAV, with variations), use generate_sound.

prompt.description: The one sound to make, with its source and character, e.g. 'retro 8-bit coin pickup, bright and short' or 'heavy sword hitting a metal shield'. One sound per call; the clip is always 1 second long

name: generate_sfx
